name: GetResponse
summary: Email marketing with landing pages, automation and webinars in one suite, priced by contact count. The better rates need long commitments.
best_for: small businesses that want email plus landing pages, automation and webinars in one affordable suite
skip_if: you only need basic broadcasts — a leaner tool costs less without the extra modules you won't use
honest_knock: Priced by contact count, so the entry number climbs as your list grows, and the best value only shows on long (annual/24-month) commitments. A solid all-rounder, but you lock in to get the good rate.

pricing.plans_source: summarised from pricing.notes; every plan name and amount appears verbatim in those notes
pricing.notes: (re-verified 2026-10-02 on their own pricing page, in euros, quoted at 1,000 contacts) Starter €16/mo or €13.12/mo billed annually: 1 automation workflow, up to 3 users. Marketer €54/mo or €44.28 annual: unlimited workflows, ecommerce tools, advanced segmentation, abandoned-cart recovery. Creator €62/mo or €50.84 annual: website builder, course creator up to 500 students, webinars. Enterprise is quote-only and adds SMS, a dedicated IP and sending domain, SSO and unlimited users. Annual billing saves a stated 18%, and prices step up at 1k, 2.5k, 5k, 10k, 25k, 50k and 100k contacts. What changed since our August 2026 reading is the free tier: the pricing page no longer sells one. It opens with a 14-day trial that needs no card, and nine fresh loads on 14 September 2026 each showed the same four plan cards with no free option among them. Free accounts have not been withdrawn altogether — the FAQ on that same page still describes a Free account that keeps working once the trial lapses, with limits on webinars, messages, landing pages, marketing automation and chats — but it is no longer a tier you can pick from the grid, so treat it as what the trial decays into rather than as a plan. One currency warning survives unchanged: that same FAQ quotes the entry plan at $19 a month for 1,000 subscribers while the plan grid served us euros, so check which currency your own checkout uses before you budget. Charities and NGOs are offered 50% off every monthly plan. Re-read on 2 October 2026: every amount above unchanged and still no Free card in the grid; the help article the FAQ links to describes the Free account as capped at 500 contacts, 2,500 messages a month and 1,000 unique visits across all landing pages, after which those pages go offline.
